जुष (कि) जोषति, यति 1. 10.
a. To rea-
son; to injure; to like. (श, ई, ञि)
To please; to serve.

जूष (षं) 1.
n. The water of boiled
pulse, pease-soup.

जुष्कक (कः) 1.
m. The water of
boiled pulse, pease-soup.

जुष्ट (ष्टं) 1.
n. The remnants of a
meal.
a. Served, obliged.

जुष्य (ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
a. That should be
served or enjoyed.
